snippet.title: Heistfest | Steam Teaser | indie.io
snippet.description:
Wishlist Heistfest now on Steam here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1451220/Heistfest/ 

Get ready for high-octane chaos in Heistfest, the ultimate arcade game where you live life on the wrong side of the law. This black and white adventure pits you against increasingly ruthless law enforcement as you mastermind daring bank heists and fight for your survival!
